title: On singular problems in nonreflexive fractional Orlicz-Sobolev spaces
summary: In this work, we deal with existence and uniqueness of positive solution $u_s$ for the singular quasilinear problem $(-Δ_Φ)^su=u^{-γ}$ in the nonreflexive fractional Orlicz-Sobolev $ W^{s}_0L^Φ(Ω)$ for $0<s<1$. Furthermore, we show that $u_s$ converges in $L^Φ(Ω)$ to the unique positive solution $u\in W^{1}_0L^Φ(Ω)$ of the problem $-Δ_Ψu=u^{-γ}$ as $s \uparrow 1$, where $Ψ$ is an appropriate $N$-function equivalent to the $N$-function $Φ$.
